newsitem.title: USA: Ameritech to resubmit Wisconsin filing.
newsitem.headline: Ameritech to resubmit Wisconsin filing.

text.p: Ameritech Corp, which is seeking to offer long-distance service in Wisconsin, said Tuesday it plans to resubmit its filing with the Wisconsin Public Service Commission, which has ruled against the telecommunications company.
The commission ruled last week that Ameritech's network does not give competitors sufficient access to offer competing local telephone service, a commission spokesman said.

Competitive access to Ameritech's local telephone network must be approved by the commission before Ameritech can apply with the Federal Communications Commission to offer long-distance service in Wisconsin.

"The commission is not yet satisfied that the interface will work with any and all competitors coming into the (local telephone) market," Ralph Deptolla, media relations manager for Ameritech in Wisconsin, told Reuters.
He said in late May the commission is expected to provide Ameritech with specific criteria it must meet.
Ameritech is seeking to offer long-distance service in Wisconsin, Michigan, Illinois, Indiana and Ohio. It offers local telephone service in portions of all five states.
